readme_content: this workflow uses illumina and oxford nanopore reads that were pre-processed to remove human-derived sequences. two assembly tools are used: spades and unicycler. in addition to assemblies (actual sequences) the two tools produce assembly graphs that can be used for visualization of assembly with bandage. more info can be found at https://covid19.galaxyproject.org/genomics/

dating the most recent common ancestor (mrca) of sars-cov-2. the workflow is used to extract full length sequences of sars-cov-2, tidy up their names in fasta files, produce a multiple sequences alignment and compute a maximum likelihood tree. more info can be found at https://covid19.galaxyproject.org/genomics/
